audit.why: 54.38% over 331 games from Fiora's side, difficulty 4/10 — she wins the 1v1 at every lane stage. The Zac-side audit records that Zac's own win rate is earned by grouping and engaging, not by the sidelane, which is why the later rows are not Fiora's.

audit.whatIsWrong: This side's chart reads Fiora/Fiora/Fiora/Fiora/Skill/Fiora/Fiora, which disagrees with the already-audited mirror at three of seven stages.
audit.why: The zac__fiora audit reconciled both layers to Fiora/Fiora/Fiora/Fiora/Fiora/Skill/Zac. Level 6 is Fiora's (Grand Challenge on an all-HP target), first item is even, and 2+ items goes to Zac on teamfight value. Leaving this side as-is guarantees mirror-fix.js overwrites it.
audit.corrected: win[4] to Fiora, win[5] to Skill, win[6] to Zac, with the full phases sides/ratings matched as one group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Only Elastic Slingshot is treated as an immobilize; Stretching Strikes (Q) — his grab, which throws two targets together — is never named as a second Riposte target, and no cooldowns appear.
audit.why: Q is 14/12.5/11/9.5/8s with a knockup/displacement; E is 21/18/15/12/9s; W is a flat 5s percent-max-health pulse. The E window at rank 1 is 21 seconds — that is the single most punishable gap in the lane and the page never says how long it is.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns and the second immobilize added to breakdown.cooldowns and dontsFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions claims Zac's Elastic Slingshot grounds and denies your Lunge.
audit.why: That comes from a derived 'grounding' flag, but Riot's own E description is only 'Zac attaches his arms to the ground and stretches back, launching himself forward' — no grounding effect on enemies. Per the calibration rule, the description wins over a misfiring flag.
audit.corrected: No grounding claim added to the page. The existing text — hold Riposte for the E landing knockup — stands.

edits.after: Profane Hydra is your duel peak, but a first-item Zac already trades your sidelane pressure for an engage somewhere else on the map.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: His E lands the knockup and it is 21s at rank 1 — punish that gap.

edits.before: - Zac Elastic Slingshot: matchup-defining — His engage. Out-duel when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Zac Elastic Slingshot: 21s at rank 1, 9s at rank 5 — his engage and the knockup you parry. - Stretching Strikes: 14s, his other immobilize. - Unstable Matter: a flat 5s. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.
